description: Header file defining the SbPlayerTestFixture class and related structures for testing media player functionality within the starboard namespace. It includes class declarations, callback functions, and methods for managing media samples, player states, and events.

classes.name: SbPlayerTestFixture
classes.description: Class for setting up and managing media player tests, including sample management, state synchronization, and event handling.

classes.name: GroupedSamples
classes.description: Encapsulates grouped audio and video samples for testing.

classes.name: GroupedSamples::AudioSamplesDescriptor
classes.description: Describes a group of audio samples with timing and stream end info.

classes.name: GroupedSamples::VideoSamplesDescriptor
classes.description: Describes a group of video samples with stream end info.

classes.name: CallbackEvent
classes.description: Represents events from the underlying player, including state changes and errors.

methods.name: SbPlayerTestFixture
methods.description: Constructor for initializing the test fixture with configuration and graphics context provider.

methods.name: Seek
methods.description: Seeks the media player to a specified timestamp.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Writes grouped audio/video samples to the player, handling EOS as needed.

methods.name: WaitForPlayerPresenting
methods.description: Blocks until the player reaches the presenting state.

methods.name: WaitForPlayerEndOfStream
methods.description: Blocks until the end of stream state is reached.

methods.name: GetCurrentMediaTime
methods.description: Returns the current media playback time.

methods.name: SetAudioWriteDuration
methods.description: Sets the duration for writing audio data ahead of current playback.

methods.name: HasAudio
methods.description: Checks if audio data is available.

methods.name: HasVideo
methods.description: Checks if video data is available.

methods.name: GetAudioSampleTimestamp
methods.description: Retrieves timestamp for a specific audio sample index.

methods.name: ConvertDurationToAudioBufferCount
methods.description: Converts a duration to the number of audio buffers.

methods.name: ConvertDurationToVideoBufferCount
methods.description: Converts a duration to the number of video buffers.
